page.layout: One page of running text, no margin notes. Running head at top with page number at top right. Numbered paragraphs 1 to 4 in one column, with Greek words at the start of paragraphs 1 to 3. Reference lines sit under the text.

main_text.p: Efficientes vtriusque Testamenti caussæ eædem hæ sunt.

1. Αἴτιον[?] κύριον[?] vnum & idem est Testamenti veteris & noui, videlicet Deus pater, qui solus, quoniam vniuersa operatur propter semetipsum, etiam impium ad diem malum, Prou.16.4. quos ab æterno elegit, ad fœderis gratiæ communionem, eosdem, quandoipsi placuit, ad sortem sanctorum in lumine, efficaciter vocat, Eph.1.4.9.

2. Μεσίτης[?] est Iesus Christus, qui Mediatorem agit inter Deum & Homines saluā-dos: quem Abraham in spiritu vidit, & gauisus est: & per quem unum Deo propin-qui facti, aditum habemus vtrique per vnum spiritum sanctum ad Patrem. 1. Tim.2.5. Ioa.8 §6. Eph.2. 13.18.

3. Συνεργοί[?] sunt, Intus quidem principaliter & efficaciter, Spiritus sanctus, qui est arrha bo hæreditatis nostræ: Eph.1.14. Foris autē, Ministri utriusq; Testamenti, qui, quoniā plātat & rigant (docēdo & sacramenta ri-te administrando) aruum Ecclesiæ Christi, Deo incrementa largiente, eiusdem ad-ministri & dispensatores mysteriorum Dei, rectè nuncupantur. prima Corinth. 3.6.9.&4.1.
4. Remota caussa est, ius Dei Opt. Max. in hominū genus, q; vt æquissimū, modera

page.notes: Greek words in paragraphs 1 to 3 are read from a small, faint scan and are uncertain; each is marked [?]. The word in paragraph 2 is hard to read. "arrha bo hæreditatis": the "bo" appears to be a printing error or stray letters and is left as printed. "8 §6." is a reference line under the text and is set as printed. Paragraph 4 is broken at the line end; the continuation "tissimum-" is recorded as the catchword.
